description: Defines an interface for providing zoneinfo data sources for timezone handling, including the ZoneInfoSource class and a factory function pointer type, along with an external factory variable.

classes.name: ZoneInfoSource
classes.description: Abstract interface for zoneinfo data sources, providing methods for reading data, skipping bytes, and retrieving version info.

methods.name: ZoneInfoSource::~ZoneInfoSource
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the ZoneInfoSource interface.

methods.name: ZoneInfoSource::Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer, similar to fread().

methods.name: ZoneInfoSource::Skip
methods.description: Skips a number of bytes in the data source, similar to fseek().

methods.name: ZoneInfoSource::Version
methods.description: Returns version information for the zoneinfo data, default implementation returns an empty string.
